policy_pretty:
ρ_1: at_ball(?v_0, ?r_1) ∧ carrying(?v_0) ∧ handempty() ∧ ¬Goal[at_ball(?v_0, ?r_0)] ⇒ move(?r_0, ?r_1)
ρ_2: at_ball(?v_0, ?v_1) ∧ handempty() ∧ ¬Goal[at_ball(?v_0, ?r_1)] ⇒ move(?r_0, ?r_1)
ρ_3: at_ball(?v_0, ?r_1) ∧ Goal[at_ball(?b_0, ?r_1)] ⇒ drop(?b_0, ?r_1)
ρ_4: at_ball(?b_0, ?r_1) ∧ at_ball(?b_0, ?v_0) ∧ carrying(?b_0) ∧ Goal[at_ball(?b_0, ?r_1)] ⇒ pick(?b_0, ?r_1)
